step1_analysis.description: A multi-tap summing amplifier used in Decision Feedback Equalization (DFE) and Feed-Forward Equalization (FFE) for high-speed serial links. It uses pseudo-differential pairs with active loads to sum weighted input signals.

paper_reference.title: A 19Gb/s Serial Link Receiver with Both 4-Tap FFE and 5-Tap DFE Functions in 45nm SOI CMOS

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * Rout. gm ~ 1mS, Rout ~ 10kOhm -> Gain ~ 10 V/V = 20 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 1.8V devices have lower ft but higher intrinsic gain than 45nm SOI, so DC gain should be comparable or slightly lower depending on bias.

sky130_expected.calculation: 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cout). Cout ~ 50fF, Rout ~ 1kOhm -> BW ~ 3.18 GHz
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 130nm node is significantly slower than 45nm SOI, so the bandwidth will be proportionally lower.
Scaled for 1.8V supply in SKY130, assuming typical CML bias currents of 1-2mA per stage.

delay.description: Propagation delay from input to output

sky130_expected.calculation: td ~ 0.69 * Rout * Cout. Rout ~ 1k, Cout ~ 50fF -> td ~ 35ps
sky130_expected.reasoning: 45nm SOI is much faster; 3ps is extremely fast, likely due to SOI and advanced node. SKY130 will be around 10x slower.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, bandwidth, power, and delay of the DFE/FFE summer.

V_LABEL_NET_8 LABEL_NET_8 0 0.9
V_LABEL_NET_9 LABEL_NET_9 0 0.9
V_LABEL_NET_10 LABEL_NET_10 0 0.9
V_LABEL_NET_11 LABEL_NET_11 0 0.9

V_INP N14 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1G)
V_INN N9 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 SIN(0.9 -0.1 1G)

XM1 N3 N13 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N12 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VDD LABEL_NET_0 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

XM6 N0 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

XM9 N1 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N6 LABEL_NET_5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

XM14 N4 LABEL_NET_8 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N4 LABEL_NET_9 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM16 N5 LABEL_NET_10 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XM17 N7 N9 N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm17} w={W_xm17}

E_diff OUT_DIFF 0 N7 N11 1.0

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1M 100G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT_DIFF) - 6.02
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1M
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(dc_gain-3) fall=1

tran 1p 5n
meas tran vout_max max v(OUT_DIFF)
meas tran vout_min min v(OUT_DIFF)
let swing = vout_max - vout_min
print swing
meas tran t_delay trig v(N14) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(OUT_DIFF) val=0 rise=1
quit
.endc
.end
